items.docs: This endpoint will automatically create budgets for several categories based on existing transactions; these budgets are returned as an array. Specifically, budgets will only be generated if the `user` has at least one `transaction` in a given category during each of the two previous calendar months. items.docs: Create a budget. This endpoint accepts the optional `MX-Skip-Webhook` header and `skip_webhook` parameter. You cannot create a duplicate budget. For example, if you attempt to create a budget for "Gas", but that budget already exist, the request will fail. You can retrieve a list of all existing categories by using the List Categories endpoint.
